اغتصبتا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَصَبَتَا (iḡtaṣabatā) /iɣ.ta.sˤa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اُغْتُصِبَتَا (uḡtuṣibatā) /uɣ.tu.sˤi.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
